[4 credits · 60 lectures]{.cp-chip}
[60 lecture decks]{.cp-chip}
:::

The course gives a unified treatment of statistical decision theory, sequential procedures and
distribution-free methods: how loss and risk functions provide a common framework for estimation
and testing, how the sample size can be decided sequentially through an SPRT, and how valid
inference can be made when no fully specified parametric model is available.

There is one deck for each lecture.

## Syllabus

| Unit | Topics | Lectures |
|:----:|:--------------------------------------------------|:------:|
| I | Decision theory: loss and risk functions; randomised and non-randomised decision rules; admissibility; complete, essentially complete and minimal complete classes; Bayes and minimax decision rules; estimation and testing viewed as decision problems; Bayes and minimax estimators; Bayes and minimax tests in simple cases. | 20 |
| II–III | Sequential analysis: SPRT and its applications to binomial, Poisson, normal, exponential and gamma populations; O.C. and A.S.N. functions; termination of the SPRT with probability one; Wald's fundamental identity and its applications. | 20 |
| IV–V | Nonparametric inference: probability integral transformation; estimation of quantiles and distribution-free confidence intervals for population quantiles; tests for randomness; runs and sign tests (one and two samples); median test; Wilcoxon and Mann–Whitney tests; one- and two-sample Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests. | 20 |

## Books

- Berger, J. O. (1985). *Statistical Decision Theory and Bayesian Analysis*, 2nd Ed., Springer-Verlag, New York.
- Conover, W. J. (1999). *Practical Nonparametric Statistics*, 3rd Ed., John Wiley & Sons, New York.
- Ferguson, T. S. (1967). *Mathematical Statistics: A Decision Theoretic Approach*, Academic Press, New York.
- Gibbons, J. D., and Chakraborti, S. (2021). *Nonparametric Statistical Inference*, 6th Ed., CRC Press, Boca Raton.
- Goon, A. M., Gupta, M. K., and Dasgupta, B. (1980). *An Outline of Statistical Theory, Volume II*, 2nd revised Ed., The World Press, Calcutta.
- Lehmann, E. L., and Romano, J. P. (2022). *Testing Statistical Hypotheses*, 4th Ed., Springer, Cham.
- Rohatgi, V. K., and Saleh, A. K. Md. E. (2015). *An Introduction to Probability and Statistics*, 3rd Ed., John Wiley & Sons, Hoboken.
- Wald, A. (1947). *Sequential Analysis*, John Wiley & Sons, New York.
